listings.name: New Movement Perth
listings.address: 6/7 Hector Street West, Osborne Park WA 6017
listings.excerpt: A 24-hour gym in Osborne Park that runs two class rooms under one roof: the Fitness Jungle, with strength and conditioning and HIIT, and a Movement Studio for Pilates and yoga, between them more than eighty classes a week. The floor has free weights, six lifting platforms and cardio kit, and there is a Movement Spa with infrared saunas and an ice bath, plus a crèche on weekday and Saturday mornings. Newcomers can start with a 7-day gym trial for $29, a 10-day class trial for $79 or a 10-day full-access trial for $109; class memberships start at $39.95 a week paid annually upfront. Staffed Monday to Thursday 7am to 8pm, Friday to 7pm and weekend mornings, with member access around the clock.
services: Infrared sauna and ice bath (Movement Spa)
